theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  have hr d e (h : relation d e) (i : Fin 9) :
      7 ∣ (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 + digits_to_num d := by
    convert ((hrelation d e).mp h).2 i using 1
    refine (sub_eq_iff_eq_add.mp ?_).symm
    rw [hdigits_to_num, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [← sub_mul, ite_sub, sub_self, ite_mul, zero_mul,
      Fintype.sum_ite_eq']
  intro d e f h
  have hd := hr d e h.1
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := Finset.dvd_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun i _ => hd i)
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib,
    Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, Int.nsmul_eq_mul] at ha
  intro i
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hd i
  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hr e f h.2 i
  have hp : IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 := ⟨3, -2, by decide⟩
  apply (hp.pow_right (n := i.1)).dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
  refine ⟨a - digits_to_num d - b - c, ?_⟩
  rw [hdigits_to_num] at ha hb hc ⊢
  linear_combination ha - hb - hc
